suggestions: reorder group by and order by clauses
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
use explicit JOIN syntax instead of comma-separated FROM clause
pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
reached_sql:
WITH nov_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS date_sk,
           d_year AS year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
),
items AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_item_sk AS item_sk,
           i_brand_id AS brand_id,
           i_brand AS brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
)
SELECT sd.year AS d_year,
       it.brand_id AS brand_id,
       it.brand AS brand,
       SUM(sd.price) AS sum_agg
FROM items AS it
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT nd.year,
           st.ss_sales_price AS price
    FROM store_sales AS st
    JOIN nov_dates AS nd ON nd.date_sk = st.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE st.ss_item_sk = it.item_sk
) AS sd ON true
GROUP BY it.brand_id, it.brand, sd.year
ORDER BY d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
